description: The plot illustrates how AUC performance varies with the parameter \(N\) for five different methods/series shown as separate colored lines. The x-axis is labeled “N” on a linear scale, spanning from 0 to 20 with labeled ticks at 0, 5, 10, 15, and 20. The y-axis is labeled “AUC (%)” on a linear scale, ranging from 75 to 100 with labeled ticks every 5 units (75, 80, 85, 90, 95, 100). A blue solid line with open circle markers starts near 94 at \(N=1\), rises to about 98 at \(N=5\), stays around 98 at \(N=10\), then declines to about 96–97 at \(N=15\) and about 94–95 at \(N=20\). A red solid line with open square markers begins around 87 at \(N=1\), increases to about 92 at \(N=5\) and about 98 at \(N=10\), then decreases to about 93 at \(N=15\) and about 91 at \(N=20\). A gold solid line with open diamond markers starts near 84 at \(N=1\), increases to about 93 at \(N=5\), about 94–95 at \(N=10\), about 95 at \(N=15\), and ends around 94–95 at \(N=20\). A green solid line with star markers begins around 86–87 at \(N=1\), rises to about 91 at \(N=5\), about 92–93 at \(N=10\), about 94–95 at \(N=15\), and then drops slightly to about 92–93 at \(N=20\). A purple solid line with downward triangle markers starts around 79 at \(N=1\), remains near 79 at \(N=5\), jumps to about 96–97 at \(N=10\), then falls to about 86 at \(N=15\) and about 82–83 at \(N=20\).
